title: Locally covering fibred functors detect exactness of abelian sheaves
statement: Fix the universes and small-skeleton convention of [def-weil-size-convention] and a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme]. Categories fibred in groupoids, their morphisms, 2-isomorphisms and 2-fibre products have the meanings of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Give each such category its big etale site: objects and arrows are those of the fibred category and coverings lie over jointly surjective etale families of schemes. Abelian sheaves mean abelian-group-valued contravariant functors satisfying the covering equalizer condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Pullback $e^{-1}$ is precomposition. For $v:\mathcal V\to\mathcal X$ and an abelian sheaf $N$ on $\mathcal V$, put $(v_*N)(x)=\Gamma(\mathcal V\times_{\mathcal X}T,N|_{\mathcal V\times_{\mathcal X}T})$ for $x$ over $T$, where $\Gamma$ is the group of compatible families over all objects and restriction is precomposition with the projection. Let $f:\mathcal U\to\mathcal X$ be a morphism such that every object $x$ of $\mathcal X$ admits an etale covering $\{x_i\to x\}$ with each $x_i$ isomorphic to $f(z_i)$ for some $z_i\in\mathcal U$. For any complex $F\xrightarrow aG\xrightarrow bH$ of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal X$, meaning $ba=0$, if the complex of precomposed sheaves $f^{-1}F\xrightarrow{f^{-1}a}f^{-1}G\xrightarrow{f^{-1}b}f^{-1}H$ is exact at its middle term, then $F\xrightarrow aG\xrightarrow bH$ is exact at $G$. In particular this criterion also applies with $F=0$ or $H=0$. No faithfulness, algebraicity or representability assumption on $f$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06XD (lemma-check-exactness-covering), with the etale topology; the augmented-complex formulation includes the degree -1 identity.

proof.text: For either site, put $K=\ker(b)$. Its sections are $K(x)=\ker(G(x)\to H(x))$ by sectionwise computation of kernels. Since $ba=0$, $a$ factors uniquely as $F\xrightarrow{c}K\hookrightarrow G$. The complex is exact at $G$ if and only if $c$ is an epimorphism, and this is equivalent to local surjectivity of $c$. Thus exactness is equivalent to the following criterion: every section $s\in G(x)$ with $b(s)=0$ is, on some covering of $x$, in the image of $a$. The identical argument applies to the assumed exact complex on $\mathcal U$.

source.place: Tag 06XD, lemma-check-exactness-covering, proof; local-section formulation from sites-modules.tex Tag 03CN, lemma-abelian-abelian (2), (5), (6).

proof.text: Fix an object $x$ and $s\in G(x)$ with $b(s)=0$. Choose the covering $r_i:x_i\to x$ and isomorphisms $\alpha_i:f(z_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}x_i$ from the hypothesis. Put $s_i=G(\alpha_i)G(r_i)(s)\in G(f(z_i))=(f^{-1}G)(z_i)$. Naturality gives $(f^{-1}b)(s_i)=H(\alpha_i)H(r_i)b(s)=0$. This uses only restriction maps and the stated local-image hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 06XD, lemma-check-exactness-covering, proof; local-section formulation from sites-modules.tex Tag 03CN, lemma-abelian-abelian (2), (5), (6).

proof.text: Apply the local lifting criterion of step 1 to the exact precomposed complex on $\mathcal U$, at $z_i$ and $s_i$. There is a covering $q_{ij}:w_{ij}\to z_i$ and $t_{ij}\in(f^{-1}F)(w_{ij})=F(f(w_{ij}))$ such that $a(t_{ij})=G(f(q_{ij}))(s_i)$. Because $f$ is a functor over schemes, the family $f(q_{ij}):f(w_{ij})\to f(z_i)$ lies over the same jointly surjective etale family as $q_{ij}$, so it is a covering in $\mathcal X$. Compose it with the singleton isomorphism-cover $\alpha_i$ and then with $r_i$. The covering axioms imply that the resulting family $r_i\alpha_i f(q_{ij}):f(w_{ij})\to x$ is a covering. Contravariant functoriality rewrites the displayed equality as $a(t_{ij})=s|_{f(w_{ij})}$.

source.place: Tag 06XD, lemma-check-exactness-covering, proof; local-section formulation from sites-modules.tex Tag 03CN, lemma-abelian-abelian (2), (5), (6).

proof.text: We have produced the local lifts required in step 1 for every kernel section over every object of $\mathcal X$. Therefore $c:F\to K$ is locally surjective, hence epic, and $F\to G\to H$ is exact at $G$. Nothing in the construction requires nonzero terms: for $F=0$ the local lifts assert that every kernel section is locally zero, and for $H=0$ every section of $G$ is a kernel section. Thus both stated endpoint cases follow as well.

source.place: Tag 06XD, lemma-check-exactness-covering, proof; local-section formulation from sites-modules.tex Tag 03CN, lemma-abelian-abelian (2), (5), (6).

proof_origin.place: Tag 06XD (lemma-check-exactness-covering), using its local covering argument and the explicit local exactness criterion of Tag 03CN(6).

lean.statement: theorem exact_of_fibred_etale_cover {S : Scheme.{u}} {U : BasedCategory.{v₁, w₁} (Over S)} {X : BasedCategory.{v₂, w₂} (Over S)} (hU : IsFibredInGroupoids U) (hX : IsFibredInGroupoids X) (f : BasedFunctor U X) (hcover : ∀ x : X.obj, ∃ R : Presieve x, R ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage.comap (X.p ⋙ Over.forget S) x ∧ ∀ (y : X.obj) (r : y ⟶ x), R r → ∃ z : U.obj, Nonempty (f.toFunctor.obj z ≅ y)) (K : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Scheme.etalePrecoverage.comap (X.p ⋙ Over.forget S)).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ a})) (L : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Scheme.etalePrecoverage.comap (U.p ⋙ Over.forget S)).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ a})) (hL : L.map (sheafToPresheaf _ _) = (K.map (sheafToPresheaf _ _)).map ((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj f.toFunctor.op)) (hexact : L.Exact) : K.Exact
lean.note: Inherited big etale sites are the Mathlib etale precoverage comapped along the projection to schemes. The equality hL identifies the underlying three-term complex with precomposition on objects and arrows; it adds no continuity or exactness assumption on f.
